fields.name: affectedByMovementSpeed
fields.summary: Is this displacement affected by movement speed multiplier?

fields.name: isCanceledByCC
fields.summary: Is this displacement canceled by crowd controls?Note the displacement will not be canceled by CCs applied previously, but by new CCs.Default value is true.

fields.name: isDodging
fields.summary: Is this displacement dodging?Dodging displacement will not cancel channels even when they're not allowed to continue while dashing.

fields.name: isFriendly
fields.summary: Is this displacement considered a friendly displacement?This is used to determine if the displacement is Airborne or Dash, and it's fed to info structs of Displacement-related action callbacks.Default value is false.

fields.name: onCancel
fields.summary: Action that is called when this displacement is canceled.This can be due to CCs, auto-canceling behaviour of DispByTarget, manual cancelation, and etc.

fields.name: onFinish
fields.summary: Action that is called when this displacement has successfully finished.

fields.name: rotateForward
fields.summary: Will the entity rotate towards its velocity during the displacement?Default value is true.

fields.name: rotateSmoothly
fields.summary: Smoothly rotate if rotateForward is on.Default value is false.

properties.name: elapsedTime
properties.summary: Time elapsed starting from the moment this displacement has started.
